skills.description: Skill package digests frozen at start; absent only on historical runs

feeding_offset.description: Append-only feeding horizon frozen with the root; missing on a historical run remains unknown
feeding_offset.title: feeding-offset@1

feeding_objects.description: Objects actually consumed by this run

product.description: product line the run is bound to

pointer.description: where the claim comes from: a JSON Pointer into the submission, or into the checked subject

reason.description: why the verdict is unknown: check error, timeout, missing input (V01 R[2])

rank.description: ranking level from the closed set the pack declares; for sorting and display only (V02)

collected_at.description: time bound: when the observation the claim rests on was collected; it holds only for that moment (A05)

items.description: reference a claim rests on: src, tree or rec; a knowledge entry is cited by its tree address

grounds.description: references the claim rests on; a knowledge entry is cited by its tree address (B01 R[5])

resolutions.description: each exact value of the statement with what it resolved to (W08, T04 R[1])

pointer.description: where the value stands, as a JSON Pointer into the submission

text.description: the exact value or quotation as the model wrote it

items.description: reference a claim rests on: src, tree or rec; a knowledge entry is cited by its tree address

references.description: what it resolved to: one or more when resolved, the candidates when ambiguous, none when unresolved

bound.description: digests the claim depends on; a change in any of them voids it

target_basis.description: how product, version and build were fixed: one claim each; provenance declared when the caller gave the value, projected when the pack rule chose it, observed when a target echoed it; grounds cite what the choice read

unversioned_root.description: product-wide knowledge root locked for this run

root.description: knowledge root locked for this run

artifact.description: Exact source_artifact record returned by this read, independent of equal-byte captures

read_manifest.description: Observed read action that returned this exact capture

meta_artifact.description: Exact metadata source_artifact returned by the same read

coverage.description: Observed coverage of the external read frozen with these bytes; absent on legacy bindings

reference.description: the bound bytes or fragment; read it with get_nodes

slot.description: input slot the source came in through

external.description: external object identity with the revision the Hub read

label.description: display name, for example the title of a linked record

sources.description: every source bound to the run besides the knowledge root: inputs and the expected sources the pack bound

layers.description: the judgment layers this requirement is judged on; other layers are not applicable

observation.description: The declared P07 observation contract for the dynamic layer

rules.description: locked rule@version identities that judge this requirement

run_interpreters.description: ledger-permitted interpreters for inline runtime tables; empty when disabled

repetition.description: V07: the repetition policy in force for this requirement, frozen with the run; absent on records stored before the field existed

basis.description: explicit: a field was written; work_class: the pack’s class default; single_round: no class, or a static-only requirement

declared.description: which parts the pack wrote itself

summary.description: one short line the model reads about the item (from the pack projection); the text of a tool result is limited, so a long list of items is shown as id, label and summary only

location.description: where the item sits in the judged source

digest.description: item fingerprint the Hub computes from the canonical fields; unchanged across runs means the item can be carried over

reuse.description: set by the Hub when the predecessor run has an unchanged item: the Hub record reference to give back in the submission to carry it over

slots.description: the slot schema to fill for each item; absent when the pack declares no slots

schema.description: JSON Schema 2020-12 of the slot record of one item, from the pack file slots.schema.json, with the closed sets the pack declares (finding codes, ranks, slot kinds)

sha256.description: SHA-256 of the pack file the schema comes from

input_defaults.description: Hub-selected input defaults frozen at start_run; absent on explicit or historical bindings

kind.description: present when the Hub copied a frozen predecessor input; absent when it bound an accepted validation record

session.description: client session id observed from the request header

submission_due.description: Absolute submission deadline; absent only on historical runs, never inferred by readers

product_pack_digest.description: Product package digest frozen at admission; absent on historical records

items.description: Knowledge tree path in canonical text, as the Hub writes it (percent escapes kept verbatim); / is the root

source_prefix.description: Knowledge tree path in canonical text, as the Hub writes it (percent escapes kept verbatim); / is the root

inverse_prefix.description: Knowledge tree path in canonical text, as the Hub writes it (percent escapes kept verbatim); / is the root

leading_parameters.description: When absent, require a unique inverse formed by a leading parameter count accepted by the locked inverse signature

inverse_alternatives.description: Pairs of enum alternative values of one signature that are each other's inverse (on/off, enable/disable); decided on the locked tree's declared enum structure, never on free text

runner.description: the user the run is executed for; absent only when the Hub itself executes a standing obligation

configurer.description: Hub user who configured the trigger (W09 F[1]); required for event, schedule and standing obligation triggers

parameters.description: parameters bound at start_run and frozen

policy.description: version of the global boundary policy table used

executors.description: digest of the executor registry used (W06 F[7]); absent while no executor is registered

groups.description: the groups the projection function returned (structure of the judged source that is not an item), frozen with the run and handed to subject builders

builds.description: the builds of the bound product the workflow asked for (workflow.context), frozen with the run so an evaluation after a restart sees the same list; absent when not asked or not bound to a product

family.description: which of the product names the build carries

line.description: version line the pack assigns to the build

base.description: the build whose tree this build uses; equals name when the build has its own tree

platform.description: platform or customer branch; null for the main platform

has_root.description: whether the knowledge base has produced the root of the build’s tree

request_digest.description: SHA-256 of the RFC 8785 canonical JSON of the start_run arguments the client key was bound to; the same key with other arguments is IDEMPOTENCY_MISMATCH (D05 R[4])

client_key_expires_at.description: end of the window in which repeating the client key returns this run

leases.description: the lease operations this run performed before it was stored (acquire's grant, extend's new end, release's keys with their former end); the fencing token stays in the lease table, never in the record

lease_context.description: the frozen lease rows of the workflow's declared prefix at start_run (every holder's rows, no tokens), `mine` marking the rows held by this run's lineage (D04 R[0])
